entries.title: Psalms 72:1
segments: <<A Psalm of Solomon.>> Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king's son.

entries.title: Psalms 72:2
segments: He will judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with justice.

entries.title: Psalms 72:3
segments: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 72:4
segments: He will judge the poor of the people, He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.

entries.title: Psalms 72:5
segments: They shall fear thee while the sun endureth, And so long as the moon, throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 72:6
segments: He will come down like rain upon the mown grass, As showers that water the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:7
segments: In his days shall the righteous flourish, And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.

entries.title: Psalms 72:8
segments: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:9
segments: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.

entries.title: Psalms 72:10
segments: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

entries.title: Psalms 72:11
segments: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him; All nations shall serve him.

entries.title: Psalms 72:12
segments: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth, And the poor, that hath no helper.

entries.title: Psalms 72:13
segments: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.

entries.title: Psalms 72:14
segments: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence; And precious will their blood be in his sight:

entries.title: Psalms 72:15
segments: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: And men shall pray for him continually; They shall bless him all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 72:16
segments: There shall be abundance of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:17
segments: His name shall endure for ever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him; All nations shall call him happy.

entries.title: Psalms 72:18
segments: Blessed be Jehovah God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things:

entries.title: Psalms 72:19
segments: And blessed be his glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen, and Amen.

entries.title: Psalms 72:20
segments: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
